title: ABNAH KPI and Chart Story Register
sourcePolicy: Schema, lineage, formulas, and redacted issue evidence only. No screenshots, full operational rows, customer fields, or local paths.
syncPolicy: Run scripts/build_control_tower_presentation.py after a Query Table or final chart change. The same contract regenerates the handbook and the site snapshot.

pages.name: Risk Action Center
pages.purpose: Show what needs action now across stockout, menu impact, expiry demonstration, and linked open purchase orders.

pages.name: Procurement, Vendor & Capital Control
pages.purpose: Explain purchase commitments, receipts, vendor performance, price movement, and capital exposure.

pages.name: Consumption Variance & Menu Profitability
pages.purpose: Connect actual and theoretical consumption to leakage, menu cost, sales, and margin.

pages.name: SCM Descriptive Explorer & Data Quality
pages.purpose: Provide governed totals, trends, drilldowns, exports, and explicit data-quality exceptions.

05_std_ct_inventory_snapshot.sql.grain: Source period, outlet, and inventory item checkpoint

reports.name: Closing Stock Report
reports.role: Current quantity, average cost, and closing valuation evidence

05_std_ct_inventory_snapshot.sql.joinLogic: No cross-report join in the final table; normalize outlet, item, period, UOM, quantity, and value.
guardrails: Use one source period for a current-state stock value.
Do not add quantities across unlike UOMs.

18_fact_ct_sales.sql.grain: Sales date, outlet, bill, and menu item

reports.name: Gross/Net Margin Report
reports.role: Bill-item sales, quantity, realized revenue, and source cost evidence

18_fact_ct_sales.sql.joinLogic: No cross-report join in the fact; preserve the validated bill-item grain.
guardrails: The sales item key is a menu item, not an inventory ingredient.
Use source purchase value only where cost coverage is approved.

19_fact_ct_theoretical_consumption.sql.grain: Source period, outlet, ingredient, and canonical UOM

reports.name: Gross/Net Margin Report
reports.role: Sold menu-item quantities used by the theoretical model

reports.name: Item Recipe Report
reports.role: Menu-item to ingredient quantity and UOM bridge

reports.name: Closing Stock Report
reports.role: Ingredient UOM and average-cost reference

reports.name: AUX Theoretical Consumption
reports.role: Synthetic three-month baseline derived from sales, recipe, UOM, and cost inputs

19_fact_ct_theoretical_consumption.sql.joinLogic: Sales quantity x governed recipe quantity x approved UOM conversion; cost value uses the normalized ingredient cost.
guardrails: The current three-month values are synthetic, while the POSIST source fields and formula pattern are factual.
Quantity comparisons require one canonical UOM.

20_fact_ct_actual_consumption.sql.grain: Source period, outlet, inventory item, and canonical UOM

reports.name: Enterprise Variance Report
reports.role: Opening, purchase, transfer, return, closing, and actual-consumption movement bridge

20_fact_ct_actual_consumption.sql.joinLogic: Actual consumption = opening + receipts + transfer in - transfer out - returns - closing.
guardrails: Signed bridge columns are report formula columns for presentation, not new source facts.
Quantity totals require one canonical UOM.

21_fact_ct_consumption_variance.sql.grain: Source period, outlet, inventory item, and canonical UOM

reports.name: Enterprise Variance Report

21_fact_ct_consumption_variance.sql.joinLogic: Join actual and theoretical consumption on source period + outlet + item; calculate signed variance, positive leakage, and low-consumption check.
guardrails: Positive leakage is not the same as signed variance.
Low consumption is a data/process check, not a favorable saving.

guardrails: Use distinct PO number for PO counts; row count is a PO-line count.
Expected-date exceptions are operational states, not automatically source defects.

23_fact_ct_purchase_receipt.sql.joinLogic: Normalize receipt identity, PO reference, quantity, subtotal, tax, and total without dropping the raw identifier.
guardrails: Weighted price is receipt subtotal divided by received quantity.
PO linkage remains sparse in the audited actual extract.

stories.name: Risk Action Center
stories.question: What exact stockout action, owner, and due band should operations see?
stories.formula: Direct fact fields; no dashboard-only calculation.

shelves: Columns: action ID, outlet, item, severity, shortage, recommended action, owner, due band
fixedFilters: Filter shelf: risk_type / Individual Values / Include STOCKOUT
zoho.sort: risk_severity_rank descending, total_risk_value descending, due_band ascending
formatting: Conditional format severity with approved RAG palette

stories.talkTrack: Risk Action Center starts from Closing Stock Report, Item Recipe Report, AUX Menu Demand Forecast, Enterprise Purchase Order Report.
